verses.en: I cried unto God with my voice, even unto God with my voice; and he gave ear unto me.
verses.sm: Atua i loʻu leo, na ou alaga atu i le Atua; ona faafofoga mai lea o ia ia te au.

verses.en: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord: my sore ran in the night, and ceased not: my soul refused to be comforted.
verses.sm: O le aso na puapuagatia ai aʻu na Ou saili atu ai i le ALII; na ou faaloaloa lo‘u lima i le po, e lei gase lava; na le mafaia loʻu loto ona faamafanafanaina.

verses.en: I remembered God, and was troubled: I complained, and my spirit was overwhelmed. Selah.
verses.sm: A ou manatua le Atua ou te atuatuvale ai; a ou mafaufau ou te loto vaivai ai.

verses.en: Thou holdest mine eyes waking: I am so troubled that I cannot speak.
verses.sm: Sela. O loo e taofia oʻu mata ina ia le 6a moe; ua ou atuatuvale;

verses.en: I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.
verses.sm: ou te le mafai ai ona tautala. Ou te manatunatu i ona po anamua;

verses.en: I call to remembrance my song in the night: I commune with mine own heart: and my spirit made diligent search.
verses.sm: o tausaga o le vavau. Ou te manatua la‘u pese i le po; ou te mafaufau i loʻu loto; e tausailiili foi loʻu agaga.

verses.en: Will the Lord cast off for ever? and will he be favourable no more?
verses.sm: E faavavau lava ea ona lafoai e le ALII? e le toe fiafia mai ea o ia?

verses.en: Is his mercy clean gone for ever? doth his promise fail for evermore?
verses.sm: Ua uma ea e faavavau lona alofa? e faaleiu ea lana afioga i lea tupulaga ma lea tupulaga?

verses.en: Hath God forgotten to be gracious? hath he in anger shut up his tender mercies? Selah.
verses.sm: Ua faagalogalo ea e le Atua ona alofa mai? pe taofi ea e ia o lona alofa mu

verses.en: And I said, This is my infirmity: but I will remember the years of the right hand of the most High.
verses.sm: timuti vale i lona toasa? Sela. Ona ou faapea ane lca, O loʻu vaivai lenei, o tausaga o le aao taumatau o le Silisili ese.

verses.en: I will remember the works of the LORD: surely I will remember thy wonders of old.
verses.sm: Ou te manatua galuega a le ALII; e moni, ou te matuā manatua ou vavega anamua.

verses.en: I will meditate also of all thy work, and talk of thy doings.
verses.sm: Ou te manatunatu foi i au galuega uma,

verses.en: Thy way, O God, is in the sanctuary: who is so great a God as our God?
verses.sm: ou te mafaufau i mea na e faia. Le Atua e, e paia lava lou ala; o ai se atua e silisili e tusa ma le Atua?

verses.en: Thou art the God that doest wonders: thou hast declared thy strength among the people.
verses.sm: O oe lava le Atua o lē fai vavega; ua faailoa lou malosi i nuu O lou aao na e faaolaina ai lou nuu,

verses.en: Thou hast with thine arm redeemed thy people, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.
verses.sm: o le fanauga a Iakopo ma Iosefa. Selā.

verses.en: The waters saw thee, O God, the waters saw thee; they were afraid: the depths also were troubled.
verses.sm: Na iloa atu le sami ia te oe le Atua e, na iloa atu le sami ia te oe, ona fefe ai lea; na gatete foi le moana.

verses.en: The clouds poured out water: the skies sent out a sound: thine arrows also went abroad.
verses.sm: 18 19 SALAMO 77, O ao uli na faamaligi ifo ai le vai; o le lagi ua taalili mai lea, ua feoai foi aw u fanafana.

verses.en: The voice of thy thunder was in the heaven: the lightnings lightened the world: the earth trembled and shook.
verses.sm: O le leo o lou faititili ua i le asiosio lea; ua malamalama le atu laulau i uila; ua gatete ma luluina le lalolagi.

verses.en: Thy way is in the sea, and thy path in the great waters, and thy footsteps are not known.
verses.sm: Ua i le sami lou ala, ua i vai e tele lou savali, o ou tulagaaao foi e le iloa lava ia.

verses.en: Thou leddest thy people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
verses.sm: Na e ta‘ita‘iina lou nuu e pei o se lafu mamoe i lima o Mose ma Arona.
